title: The BFG
author: Roald Dahl
summary: A young orphan is carried off in the night by a giant who turns out to be kind. Together they set out to stop larger, nastier giants who prey on children.
readIf: you like silly invented words, dream-catching and a friendship between a small girl and a huge, bumbling giant.
skipIf: you want a story without any mild peril or a lot of gross-out humour.

pairings.reason: Another Dahl story in which a small, sharp child outwits the grown-ups around her.
Shares the same cheerful absurdity and an orphaned hero who finds odd, loyal companions.
A longer and more serious tale of imagination, for readers ready to go further into fantasy.
